                                     ADMISSION NOTICE



This      for information to all the students of FYUGP B.A. 3d and 5" Semester that admission
process for the Academic Sesion 2026-2027 will be conducted as per the following Schedulc.

The Admission fee for APL students is Rs.3630/
(The fee will be accepted only through online mode.)

Documents Required:
      1. Previous semester admission receipt.(original & photocopy)
      2. All last semester Grade-Sheet. (original & photocopy)
       3. Declaration Form
      4. Income Certificate by SDCRation Card(Below 4 Lakhs) (original & photocopy)
Admission willbe held under Fee waiver Scheme as per Govt. guidelines.
       1. Thestudents must pass the Examinations of the last academic session.
      2. Students who have arrears/backlogs in the previous academic year have to submit an
         undertaking to be provided by the College.
      3. Further, students who have not enrolled for the final examinations of the previous
         academic year shall not be eligible to avail of the Fee Waiver Scheme.
